decisions.reason: The check-in app was featured on the home page as part of the firm's announced push into aviation innovation, and its weak results during the pandemic can still be blamed on the temporary collapse of air travel just as traffic recovers in 2022.

PassBoard was publicly launched with a dated announcement, is a multi-model product line that absorbed substantial in-house development, and sits at the core of the firm's stated ambition to lead high-end security through innovation, so management will persist and await the post-COVID aviation rebound.

The self-service check-in solution builds on the established airport offer and was visibly promoted, and contactless self-service gains relevance after the pandemic, so disappointing figures are read as temporary rather than as a reason to withdraw.
